integrity: The lower boundary is established by complete labeled graph generation through five vertices, exact relabeling canonicalization, exact integer characteristic polynomials, and rational isolation of the spectral radius. The six-vertex witness and the all-larger-order star-cycle family are proved symbolically.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns simple undirected connected equal-order contact graphs and compares the classical inverse-average-degree homogeneous threshold with the adjacency-spectral SIS mean-field threshold. It does not identify the exact extinction threshold of the finite stochastic SIS Markov chain and does not cover directed, weighted, temporal, multilayer, or unequal-order network comparisons.
title: Six vertices are the sharp density–spectral epidemic-ranking reversal boundary
